INSERT INTO provider_drama_content_sync_task (drama_id, status, requested_at, next_run_at) VALUES (#{dramaId}, 'REQUESTED', #{requestedAt}, #{requestedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE requested_at = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN requested_at ELSE VALUES(requested_at) END, next_run_at = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN next_run_at ELSE VALUES(next_run_at) END, retry_count = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN retry_count ELSE 0 END, total_fetched = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN total_fetched ELSE 0 END, inserted_count = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN inserted_count ELSE 0 END, updated_count = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN updated_count ELSE 0 END, last_error_code = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN last_error_code ELSE NULL END, last_error_message = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN last_error_message ELSE NULL END, lease_owner = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN lease_owner ELSE NULL END, lease_until = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN lease_until ELSE NULL END, status = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN status ELSE 'REQUESTED' END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_drama_content_sync_task SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND (status = 'REQUESTED' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= #{now})) AND next_run_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})

UPDATE provider_drama_content_sync_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', retry_count = 0, total_fetched = #{totalFetched}, inserted_count = #{insertedCount}, updated_count = #{updatedCount}, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner}

UPDATE provider_drama_content_sync_task SET status = 'REQUESTED', next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner}

UPDATE provider_drama_content_sync_task SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner}
